entities.summary: Nison-in  is a Tendai Buddhist temple complex in Ukyō-ku, a western ward in the city of Kyoto, Japan. The temple's official name is Ogura-yama Nison-kyō-in Keidai-ji . The temple is a popular destination during the Japanese maple viewing season.
